name: foundations

notes: The full run needs Docker and ./scripts/setup-local-runtime; KCC status is simulated and cloud behaviour is unverified.
Live cloud checks need a user-authorised boundary recorded in the issue. Credentials or a kubeconfig are not authorisation.
There is no PR CI workflow; record local results against the tested commit.

invariants: Native KCC objects and shallow KRO graphs using KRO's real schema/CEL engine; no alternate runner, API shell Job, custom controller or compliance DSL.
One writer per resource/policy surface; typed references, readiness, mutability, retention and consumer compatibility are composition contracts.
Verify features against pinned KCC kinds and fields; unsupported features stay explicit.
Schema or producer changes need affected-consumer tests; security rules need allowed and denied cases; lifecycle claims need runtime checks.
Local, simulated and live evidence stay separate; never present simulated status as live or a skipped check as passed.
Cloud mutations need an explicit user-authorised boundary; never delete or adopt existing infrastructure or change production IAM or billing.
Catalog usage-guide tables inside marked blocks are maintained by scripts/catalog_docs.py, not by hand.
